summary: Kinetic Seas Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that it executed and completed a Third Addendum to its Licensing Agreement with Sagtec Global Limited on July 27, 2026. The addendum required the return of 2,000,000 consideration shares to Sagtec, modified Rule 144 provisions, eliminated a right of first refusal, and added commercial arrangements. Sagtec designated a nominee to receive the returned shares, and Kinetic Seas executed the transfer instructions on July 27. This is a routine contract amendment and share transfer, not a special situation.
